name: at-picker
description: File picker pane that inserts @mentions into the prompt

icons.title: Toolbar icons
icons.description: unicode: glyphs any monospace font draws. nerd: Nerd Font icons (an eye for hidden files); needs a Nerd Font in the terminal.

uiLanguage.title: Interface language
uiLanguage.description: auto follows the terminal locale (LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG); English when it is not Spanish.

dockWidthPercent.title: Dock width (%)
dockWidthPercent.description: Width of the docked picker as a share of the terminal; at least 24 columns, at most 45%.

inlineMode.title: Below 110 columns
inlineMode.description: panel: show the picker inline above the prompt. message: show only an insufficient-space notice.

inlineRows.title: Inline height (rows)
inlineRows.description: Body rows asked for when the picker sits inline; the engine trims it to what the layout spares.

showHidden.title: Show hidden files
showHidden.description: List dotfiles and dot-directories. The 1 key toggles it for the session.

sortDirs.title: Sort folders too
sortDirs.description: Apply the 5 key's sort order to folders as well; folders still come first. Off: folders always by name. By size, folders stay by name (a folder has no size of its own).

debug.title: Debug log
debug.description: Log pane sizes and actions to Claude Code's debug log (claude --debug) and show a diagnostic header. Development only.
